text:
```yaml
name: Deploy private-location to Fly.io

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'apps/private-location/**'
      - 'apps/checker/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Flyctl
        uses: fly-apps/flyctl-action@v1
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
        working-directory: apps/private-location
        run: flyctl deploy --remote-only
```

name: Deploy private-location to Fly.io

      - 'apps/checker/**'

permissions:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Flyctl
        uses: fly-apps/flyctl-action@v1

          version: latest

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
        working-directory: apps/private-location
